title: Doxie Creek Bridge, Spanning Doxie Creek at State Route 5, Forest Green, Chariton County, MO
notes: Significance: The Doxie Creek Bridge is a five-span, rigid-connected Warren pony truss, and is significant as a skewed example of a common truss type.
